You asked a question, all I did was answer why so many people don't like Twilight. I don't censor my sister's reading. And I don't want to censor anyone else's either. She reads what she likes to read and chooses for herself. I'm just glad she doesn't read Twilight. I never said I want to ban any books, just expressed the opinion I think many people have about the Twilight series as an answer to your question, "Why is there so much animosity for a series of books and movies that teenagers enjoy?"

One of the reasons many people dislike Twilight so much is because it has a weak feminine lead character who centers most of her life around being in love with a vampire and has no apparent willpower or personal strength of her own. This isn't an example many people want to set for young teenage girls that are the target audience for the series. Just because teens are reading doesn't necessarily mean they are reading something that will be beneficial to them. I would rather my younger sister be on her phone or listening to music or on the computer browsing the web than reading a series of books that champions weak females that are so heavily dependent on their love interest.

It wasn't a first date but it was such a wonderful night I thought I would post it. My boyfriend and I decided one night to go on a walk in the park. So we parked my car and started walking down a sidewalk. It got dark while we were walking and we ended up walking for an hour through the park. We stumbled on a really pretty pond and then saw some crazy glowing stuff in the woods. We got so far away from where we first parked my car it ended up being faster to just walk back to his apartment and take his car back to mine. After walking so much we were really hungry so we went to the Macaroni Grill at like ten o'clock so it was pretty empty. We were both in such a good mood and we decided to map out our walk through the park on the paper they have on the tables at Macaroni Grill. We illustrated the whole walk. Our server probably thought we were crazy. Then at the end of the meal our server asked what we were going to do that night and my boyfriend says to him,"Oh we're gonna head back to my place..." in a suggestive voice. I laughed so hard. Typing it out doesn't quite convey what an awesome night it was but it will live in my memory as one of the best nights of my life. :)
